تستشعروا (form X)
# تَسْتَشْعِرُوا (tastašʕirū) /tas.taʃ.ʕi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
# تُسْتَشْعَرُوا (tustašʕarū) /tus.taʃ.ʕa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَشْعَرَ (istašʕara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
